bitnami/common
It is required by CI/CD tools and processes.

ingress.description:
Configure the ingress resource that allows you to access the YOURLS installation
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/ingress/

secrets.description:
Custom TLS certificates as secrets
NOTE: 'key' and 'certificate' are expected in PEM format
NOTE: 'name' should line up with a 'secretName' set further up
If it is not set, and you're using cert-manager, this is unneeded, as it will create a secret for you with valid certificates
If it is not set, and you're NOT using cert-manager either, self-signed certificates will be created valid for 365 days
It is also possible to create and manage the certificates outside this helm chart
Please see README.md for more information
e.g:
secrets:
- name: yourls.local-tls
key: |-
...
certificate: |-
...

affinity.description:
Affinity for pod assignment
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/assign-pod-node/#affinity-and-anti-affinity
NOTE: podAffinityPreset, podAntiAffinityPreset, and  nodeAffinityPreset will be ignored when it's set

allowEmptyPassword.description: Allow the container to be started with blank passwords

args.description: Override default container args (useful when using custom images)

command.description: Override default container command (useful when using custom images)

commonAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to all deployed objects

commonLabels.description: Labels to add to all deployed objects

customLivenessProbe.description: Custom livenessProbe that overrides the default one

customPostInitScripts.description:
Custom post-init.d user scripts
ref: https://github.com/YOURLS/docker/blob/main/docker-entrypoint.sh
NOTE: supported formats are `.sh`, `.sql` or `.php`
NOTE: scripts are exclusively executed during the 1st boot of the container
e.g:
customPostInitScripts:
enable-feature.sh: |
!/bin/bash
...
.htaccess: |
RewriteEngine On
RewriteBase /
...

customReadinessProbe.description: Custom readinessProbe that overrides the default one

customStartupProbe.description: Custom startupProbe that overrides the default one

diagnosticMode.description: Enable diagnostic mode in the deployment

externalDatabase.description:
External Database Configuration
All of these values are only used if `mariadb.enabled=false`

extraContainerPorts.description:
Optionally specify extra list of additional ports for YOURLS container(s)
e.g:
extraContainerPorts:
- name: myservice
containerPort: 9090

extraDeploy.description: Array of extra objects to deploy with the release

extraEnvVars.description:
Array with extra environment variables to add to the YOURLS container
e.g:
extraEnvVars:
- name: FOO
value: "bar"

extraEnvVarsCM.description: Name of existing ConfigMap containing extra env vars

extraEnvVarsSecret.description: Name of existing Secret containing extra env vars

extraVolumeMounts.description: Optionally specify extra list of additional volumeMounts for YOURLS container(s)

extraVolumes.description: Optionally specify extra list of additional volumes for YOURLS pods

ingress.description:
Configure the ingress resource that allows you to access the YOURLS installation
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/ingress/

enabled.description: Enable ingress record generation for YOURLS

initContainers.description:
Add additional init containers to the YOURLS pod(s)
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/
e.g:
initContainers:
- name: your-image-name
image: your-image
imagePullPolicy: Always
command: ['sh', '-c', 'echo "init"']

lifecycleHooks.description: for the WordPress container(s) to automate configuration before or after startup

commonLabels.description: Common labels to add to all MariaDB resources (sub-charts are not considered)

enabled.description:
Deploy a MariaDB server to satisfy the applications database requirements
To use an external database set this to false and configure the `externalDatabase.*` parameters

existingSecret.description:
Name of a secret containing the previous passwords (set if the password secret was already changed)
Configure Container Security Context
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/#set-the-security-context-for-a-container

password.description: Previous password (set if the password secret was already changed)

replicationPassword.description: Previous replication password (set if the password secret was already changed)

rootPassword.description: Previous root password (set if the password secret was already changed)

nodeSelector.description:
Node labels for pod assignment
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/user-guide/node-selection/

podAffinityPreset.description:
Pod affinity preset. Ignored if `affinity` is set. Allowed values: `soft` or `hard`
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/#inter-pod-affinity-and-anti-affinity

podAntiAffinityPreset.description:
Pod anti-affinity preset. Ignored if `affinity` is set. Allowed values: `soft` or `hard`
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/#inter-pod-affinity-and-anti-affinity

podLabels.description:
Extra labels for YOURLS pods
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/

replicaCount.description:
Number of YOURLS replicas to deploy
NOTE: ReadWriteMany PVC(s) are required if replicaCount > 1

sidecars.description:
Add additional sidecar containers to the YOURLS pod
e.g:
sidecars:
- name: your-image-name
image: your-image
imagePullPolicy: Always
ports:
- name: portname
containerPort: 1234

topologySpreadConstraints.description:
Topology Spread Constraints for pod assignment
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/
YOURLS containers' resource requests and limits
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/user-guide/compute-resources/

updateStrategy.description:
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/deployment/#strategy
NOTE: Set it to `Recreate` if you use a PV that cannot be mounted on multiple pods
e.g:
updateStrategy:
type: RollingUpdate
rollingUpdate:
maxSurge: 25%
maxUnavailable: 25%
